title: External MLL23 evaluation
label: tab:exp40-external-mll23
caption: Results on the external MLL23 evaluation.
description: This table compares Ours with four baselines on external MLL23 classification performance and mechanism-response measurements. Its purpose is to assess whether the observed class and dependency behavior extends beyond the primary evaluation; it does not establish MLL23 attribute correctness.
context_notes: Values are reported mean ± sample standard deviation over seeds 17, 29, and 43.
N/A denotes an unsupported method-output contract, not zero.
This is bounded external class/path evidence and does not test MLL23 attribute correctness.
